start: Owner online, Challenges, no challenge running

steps.action: Tap 'New challenge'; fill 'Name', 'What counts', the goal, 'First day', 'How many days', 'Free days for everyone who reaches the goal'
user_sees: Sheet 'New challenge'
Hints 'Members see this name. At most 60 letters.', 'Today or a later day, up to 60 days from today.', 'From 7 to 31 days.', 'From 0 to 60. You check each winner before the days are added.'
A preview of what members will read
must_not: 'Fill in the boxes above to see what members will read.' left when all boxes are filled

user_sees: Toast 'Challenge saved. Members see it in the MettleUp app within 10 minutes.'
The challenge card with who has reached the goal
must_not: Two challenges that overlap
A second challenge from a double tap
Free days added before the owner checks a winner

start: Owner online, Challenges, the ready-made challenges list at the top

steps.action: Tap the turn-on button of a ready-made challenge
user_sees: Button shows it is saving
A toast that names the challenge and its first day
must_not: Another ready-made one can be tapped while this one saves
It starts over a running challenge

steps.action: Try one when another challenge fills the next 60 days
user_sees: 'Another challenge takes up the next 60 days, so this one cannot be turned on yet.'
must_not: A silent no-op

start: Owner online; a challenge has finished and winners wait

steps.action: On a winner tap the give button; on another tap 'Skip'
user_sees: Button reads 'Saving…'
A line for each winner that says what happened
must_not: Free days given twice
Days given to a member who was skipped
A winner’s row gone with no word

steps.action: Tap the give-all button for the rest
user_sees: 'Done for <n> winners. Each line says what happened.'
must_not: A failure half-way shown as all done
A receipt made for free days

user_sees: 'List copied. You can paste it into WhatsApp.'
must_not: A message sent to members by itself

start: Owner on the New challenge sheet; also the gym offline or the server part missing

steps.action: Type a name over 60 letters, a goal of 0, a first day in the past, 5 days, 61 free days; save
user_sees: A plain problem line for the first wrong box
must_not: A challenge saved with a wrong value
The typed values wiped

steps.action: Open Challenges with the gym not online
user_sees: 'Challenges need your gym online' or 'Challenges are not switched on for your gym yet'
must_not: An editor that cannot save

start: Owner online; one challenge not started yet, the leaderboard has members

steps.action: Open the challenge and change it ('Change the challenge'); then cancel it and confirm 'Cancel this challenge?'
user_sees: Toast 'Challenge cancelled. Members no longer see it.'
'No challenge is running'
must_not: A started challenge changed instead of only cancelled
Winners’ days taken back by a cancel

steps.action: On 'Leaderboard · last 30 days' tap 'Hide from the leaderboard' on a member, then 'Show again'
user_sees: Toast '<name> is hidden from the leaderboard.'
The member under 'Hidden from members'
Toast '<name> is on the leaderboard again.'
must_not: The hidden member still shown to other members
The member’s own totals deleted by hiding

start: Owner looks at the leaderboard and the winners list

user_sees: Names with workouts or kg; a winner’s phone number next to the name
must_not: Body weight, photos or which exercises a member did
A member who switched their name off shown by name to other members
Another gym’s members

start: Staff online, Challenges; the owner runs a challenge

user_sees: 'Only the owner can start, change or cancel a challenge. You can see who has reached the goal.'
The challenge card with members who reached the goal
'Leaderboard · last 30 days'
must_not: 'New challenge', turn-on, change, cancel, give or skip controls for staff
A hide button on the leaderboard

user_sees: 'No challenge is running' with 'The owner has not started one.'
must_not: A start button
Ready-made challenges staff can turn on

start: Staff online; a challenge finished and the owner has not yet given the free days

steps.action: Read the winners list before and after the owner gives
user_sees: Before: each winner with a line that the free days wait; after a reload: what was given
must_not: Give or Skip buttons for staff
Old state kept after reload
